test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that expresses the given sentence in Indirect speech.

She said, "I cannot call you at this time."

options.text: She said that she would not call me at this time.
She said that she could not call me this time.
She said that she cannot call me at that time.
She said that she could not call me at that time.

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** She said that she could not call me at that time.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"I cannot call you" becomes "she could not call me"**
 
 
• The first person pronoun "I" is changed to "she" to match the third person in indirect speech.
 
• The modal verb "cannot" is changed to "could not" to match the past tense in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **"at this time" becomes "at that time"**
 
 
• The demonstrative "this" is changed to "that" to match the context of indirect speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Indirect speech does not require quotation marks.
 
• The reporting clause is followed by the reported clause without any additional punctuation.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *She said that she could not call me at that time.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "She said that she would not call me at this time." 
 
 
• Incorrect conversion of the modal verb "cannot" to "would not" changes the meaning.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "She said that she could not call me this time." 
 
 
• The demonstrative "this" should be changed to "that" in indirect speech to maintain the correct context.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "She said that she cannot call me at that time." 
 
 
• The modal verb "cannot" should be changed to "could not" to match the past tense in indirect speech.
 
 

``
